late11_categories.partial_controllability: reliable signed target delay reduced by >=4frames at both thresholds, lower same-frame error, no gross edit failure; not a full rescue

phase_response_gate: Require meaningful ordered response of phase_plus12/zero/minus12, primary dual thresholds and declared wider-range sensitivity retained. Zero must lie between endpoints within2frames; endpoint separation>=6frames is an exploratory minimum, not statistical significance. One-sided saturation is weak evidence requiring further calibration, not an automatic controller proof.
phase_fallback: If +/-12 is disordered, unchanged, or causes pose/appearance failure, at most one predeclared smaller signed pair +/-4 physicalframes may be used to check large-perturbation nonlinearity. Keep all12 results. No parameter grid or best-only report.
